# secobserve_license_group (Data Source)

Looks up a license group by id or exact name.

This is the documented way to reference the system-managed `(ScanCode LicenseDB)` groups, which are reimported nightly and should not be owned by `secobserve_license_group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The ScanCode LicenseDB groups are system-managed and reimported nightly;
# reference them read-only rather than owning them with the resource.
data "secobserve_license_group" "scancode_permissive" {
  name = "Permissive (ScanCode LicenseDB)"
}

output "scancode_permissive_license_ids" {
  value = data.secobserve_license_group.scancode_permissive.licenses
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the license group. Supply either this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the license group. Supply either this or `id`. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, even though SecObserve's own filter is a substring match.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `has_authorization_groups` (Boolean) Whether this group has at least one authorization group member.
- `has_licenses` (Boolean) Whether this group contains at least one license.
- `has_users` (Boolean) Whether this group has at least one user member.
- `is_in_license_policy` (Boolean) Whether any license policy item references this group.
- `is_manager` (Boolean) Whether the provider's identity is an explicit manager member of this group. A superuser can manage the group through the resource regardless of this flag.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether every authenticated user can see this group, not just members.
- `licenses` (Set of Number) Ids of the licenses currently in this group.
